scope: ADR field contract review only; no source-record, runtime, schema, or Aura writes

canonical_source.identity_rule: scripts/knowledge_query.py::_extract_nodes_from_md_file uses non-empty frontmatter id if present, otherwise the complete filename stem. Do not replace canonical_id with the short ADR-NNN prefix.
canonical_source.revision_rule: Read the source document at Entity.source.source_sha and Entity.source.path, with its recorded content_hash, not the current working-tree document when backfilling a retained generation.
canonical_source.frontmatter_locator: YAML mapping enclosed by whole-line --- delimiters at the start of the file
canonical_source.body_locator: Markdown after the closing frontmatter delimiter; documents without frontmatter still have body content
canonical_source.source_is_open_mapping_reason: The frontmatter validator checks required fields and selected values; it does not reject additional field names. Preserve supplied extension fields without declaring them universally required.

authorities.role: ADR authoring source of truth: frontmatter rules, mandatory body sections, distinct ADR lifecycle, cross-links
Scaffold for ADR frontmatter and five mandatory body sections
General architecture metadata reference; ADR-specific affects_diagrams rule
Mechanically enforced six-field required set and frontmatter status vocabulary
Null-required-field refusal, component IDs and path shape validation
Path-bearing entries may be a string or a single-key label-to-path mapping
Native ADR document genre and author routing
Current projection drops all ADR frontmatter except producer title and description
Existing identity, title and description fallback rules to preserve

field_inventory.name: id
field_inventory.rule: Existing producer supports it as an optional identity override; absence leaves filename-stem identity. Never invent a native id frontmatter field when absent.
field_inventory.recommended_property: native pointer /id on collision, existing id remains canonical identity

field_inventory.name: title
field_inventory.rule: Authoring guide expects ADR-NNN: prefix matching filename. Keep exact supplied value; preserve legacy producer fallback separately when source title is absent.

field_inventory.name: description
field_inventory.required: ADR authoring guide requires it; generic mechanical validator and scaffold do not
field_inventory.rule: One or two sentences stating decision and reason. Entity.summary is currently a producer-selected description OR first body line; do not mistake fallback summary for present source description.

field_inventory.name: type
field_inventory.rule: Document type is separate from Entity.kind. Preserve legacy source type tutorial without rewriting it to adr; graph kind remains ADR because the source is on the ADR surface.

field_inventory.name: status
field_inventory.rule: Document lifecycle only; never substitute the body decision lifecycle.

field_inventory.name: created
field_inventory.type: ISO date string or YAML date scalar
field_inventory.rule: YYYY-MM-DD; immutable first-authored date. Normalize YAML date objects with isoformat for JSON/Neo4j compatibility, keeping value and date-type provenance rather than datetime repr.

field_inventory.name: last_updated
field_inventory.type: ISO date string or YAML date scalar
field_inventory.rule: YYYY-MM-DD; last substantive source edit. Not the graph ingestion timestamp.

field_inventory.name: components
field_inventory.rule: Registered IDs or accepted registry aliases. Preserve original order/duplicates in native source representation; existing display components is a sorted deduplicated graph-membership convenience value.
field_inventory.recommended_property: components when it faithfully equals source; otherwise retain existing display components plus source pointer /components

field_inventory.name: deciders
field_inventory.required: included in ADR authoring guide example; no explicit universal required rule
field_inventory.rule: Names or agents authoring/approving decision. No inferred person identities. Distinct from raw body Decider/Deciders table row.

field_inventory.name: affects_diagrams
field_inventory.required: architecture frontmatter reference calls it required with [] for none; generic mechanical validator does not require it and ADR authoring guide omits it
field_inventory.rule: Paths of governed diagrams, with diagram related_adrs backlinks. Preserve [] distinctly from absent; do not fabricate [] for 55 absent records.

field_inventory.name: related_docs
field_inventory.required: ADR guide says list all applicable cross-references; general ADR reference labels optional
field_inventory.rule: Preserve source declarations even when referenced surface is not projected or graph edge resolution declines the target. The shared resolver accepts labeled path entries.
field_inventory.recommended_property: related_docs for homogeneous string lists; indexed pointer leaves for any labeled/mixed entries

field_inventory.name: related_code
field_inventory.required: ADR guide says list governed modules; general ADR reference labels optional
field_inventory.rule: Every directly governed module/script/config. Currently not among ADR edge_fields, so absence of Neo4j edges does not mean source references are absent.
field_inventory.recommended_property: related_code for homogeneous string lists; indexed pointer leaves for any labeled/mixed entries

field_inventory.name: architecture_diagrams
field_inventory.rule: Generic validator-supported optional path field; not an alias for affects_diagrams. Preserve if supplied.

field_inventory.name: amended
field_inventory.rule: Observed extension; no global ADR schema requirement. Do not overwrite with body Amended prose.

field_inventory.name: requires_ac
field_inventory.rule: Observed extension; preserve explicit AC reference TKT-300a without inventing a required graph relationship.

field_inventory.name: tags
field_inventory.rule: Observed extension, not required by ADR scaffold or validator.

field_inventory.name: other supplied frontmatter keys
field_inventory.rule: The schema is open. Expose scalar/list values directly and structured values via faithful pointer leaves; do not discard them through a hard-coded allowlist.

body_contract.distinction: ADR body is native document content, not frontmatter. Do not invent required frontmatter author, date, supersedes, context, decision, consequences or alternatives keys from the body template.

representation_recommendation.body: Expose exact Markdown body as a content string if this change includes content visibility. This preserves nonstandard headings, amendments, and prose without guessing semantic structure.
representation_recommendation.status_metadata: For the actual first two-column metadata table directly under a Status heading, retain an ordered array of {label, value} rows and explicit source locators. Preserve raw Markdown and unknown row labels. Do not accidentally consume later tables elsewhere in that section/document.
representation_recommendation.convenience_rule: Only populate from unambiguous corresponding body metadata rows; keep raw strings. Never overwrite frontmatter status/created/deciders. For prose-only statuses preserve raw status section; do not infer acceptance dates or lifecycle from arbitrary prose.
representation_recommendation.structured_sections: Optional ordered array of {heading, level, content, source_locator}; retain exact source spelling and nesting. A full raw body is preferable to lossy ad-hoc section parsing if structured body extraction is beyond scope.

null_and_absence_semantics.required_field: Mechanical validator treats both omitted and explicit null as missing. Projection must expose observed source truth and report it, not silently insert a default or drop the whole legacy ADR.
null_and_absence_semantics.optional_absent: No native property; absence evidence comes from present-field inventory or source field state. Absence is not an empty string/list and is not false.
null_and_absence_semantics.explicit_null: Neo4j null deletes a property; retain an explicit native null-path list so null remains distinguishable from omitted.
null_and_absence_semantics.empty_list_or_mapping: Retain container type/path metadata so [] and {} remain visible and reconstructable even when there are no leaf values.
null_and_absence_semantics.literal_none_tokens: Body Supersedes values '-', em dash, 'None', or explanatory prose are source strings, not YAML/JSON null. Do not translate these to null automatically.
null_and_absence_semantics.dates: PyYAML produces datetime.date for unquoted dates and str for quoted dates; convert deliberately to a supported representation without converting missing dates to today's date.

already_in_entity: summary (description or first body line fallback)
already_in_graph_presentation: components derived from resolved direct membership edges
omitted_even_from_payload: source description field presence/value independent of summary fallback
current_projection_gap.relationships_do_not_replace_fields: ADR declared edge_fields are only related_docs and components. Resolution can decline targets; even a resolved edge does not preserve all source list ordering, labels, empty/null states or unprojected references.

representation_assessment.native_scalar_fields: Use existing source names for directly viewable/filterable strings, booleans and numbers.
representation_assessment.native_scalar_lists: Homogeneous primitive arrays remain ordinary array properties; retain source order and duplicates.
representation_assessment.nested_fields: Escaped JSON Pointer property keys are appropriate: a labeled path entry can be exposed as /related_docs/0/explanation, while a later plain entry remains /related_docs/1. This preserves label, order and correlation without additional bookkeeping nodes.
representation_assessment.pointer_escaping: Escape '~' to '~0' and '/' to '~1' in each object-key segment. Retain array indices. Do not join nested object arrays into parallel lists.
representation_assessment.containers_and_nulls: Keep explicit container paths/types and null paths; use a reserved metadata namespace and present-field inventory to prevent source keys from colliding with these helpers.
representation_assessment.collision_rules: Existing canonical identity, generation/current flags, key, payload, provenance, and storage hash keys remain authoritative. Any conflicting source field retains its complete value under an unambiguous source pointer/prefix. Source components may differ from sorted graph membership; source status must never be replaced with body ADR status.
representation_assessment.no_json_only_fallback: Do not hide nested values solely in a serialized JSON property. Pointer leaves must remain directly inspectable/filterable. Raw JSON may be an additional integrity representation only.

isolated_coder_module_contract.suggested_output: Raw native field mapping plus explicitly sourced optional body metadata/content; shared projection layer performs Neo4j flattening, reserved-key protection, type/null/container metadata.
isolated_coder_module_contract.parsing_warning: scripts.knowledge_frontmatter_reader is deliberately partial and stdlib-only: it loses explicit null/empty block values and does not faithfully parse nested labeled path entries or arbitrary multiline YAML. Do not use its output as a complete native metadata representation. Full YAML parsing may be owned by the new isolated projection extractor without altering the legacy producer or its dependency contract.
isolated_coder_module_contract.no_source_migration: Do not repair historical ADR metadata during projection. Preserve actual values and separately report native contract gaps.

schema_disagreements: ADR authoring guide requires description but six-field validator and scaffold do not.
Architecture frontmatter reference calls affects_diagrams required; only one of 56 ADRs declares it, as []. Generic validator does not require it.
ADR-001 has source type tutorial and lacks frontmatter title/components.
ADR-003 has no frontmatter; all six mechanically required fields are absent.
Several ADRs use prose Status instead of the current prescribed table, and raw status strings can exceed the guide's four expected values.

recommended_behavioral_checks: Real ADR-056 frontmatter round-trips all source fields; status active and body adr_status Accepted are separately visible.
A labeled related_docs entry plus a plain path remains ordered, labeled and directly filterable through pointer properties.
Absent, null, [], {}, false, 0 and empty string retain distinct source states.
Explicit YAML date and quoted date both project without unsupported date objects or silent value changes.
Legacy ADR-003 remains present with body content and absent-frontmatter metadata, without fabricated native fields.
Reserved id/current/key/payload/source_path collisions cannot overwrite graph identity/provenance; conflicting raw values remain visible.
Source component order and duplicates remain recoverable even if existing graph membership display remains sorted/deduplicated.
Retained snapshot backfill verifies source_sha/path/hash and does not take metadata from a later working-tree revision.
